svg.title: Storage Platform Architecture and Scope of Responsibility
svg.desc: Object, file, block, and KV services use a core software platform with a persistent storage pool and a distributed memory pool. Shared principles include compute–storage disaggregation, separation of the data and control planes, and hardware–software co-design. The hardware platform includes NICs, SSD controllers, NPUs and CPUs, DRAM, NAND flash (TLC/QLC), HDDs (HAMR/SMR), and tape. The red dashed boundary marks responsibility for platform software and co-design across software, hardware, and storage media. Upper-layer services are outside this boundary.
svg.text: Platform Software · Hardware and Media Co-Design
